description: This file is a Streamlit application script for generating and practicing medical exam questions. It includes UI components for configuration, question generation via an agent, batch processing, and a practice mode with navigation and answer validation.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent responsible for generating batch questions based on chapter, difficulty, and image inclusion parameters.

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronous method to generate a batch of questions for a specific chapter, with specified count, difficulty, image inclusion, and concurrency.
